summary.text: David William Kiner is the Democratic and Working Families Party candidate for Connecticut State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent John Kissel (R / Independent Party of Connecticut).
He previously represented District 59 in the Connecticut House of Representatives from 2011 to 2017.

paragraphs.text: David William Kiner earned a B.A. in political science from Eastern Connecticut State University.
Kiner assumed office in the Connecticut House of Representatives in 2011 and left in 2017.
Ballotpedia lists his committee assignments in the 2015 session as vice chair of General Law, and member of Labor and Public Employees and of Public Safety and Security.
